theme: 财经 · 通货膨胀与你的钱包
goals: 理解通货膨胀的基本概念及其对日常生活的影响
掌握 30 个与财经、物价、消费相关的核心词汇
能够用英语简单讨论物价上涨和个人理财策略
熟悉财经新闻中常见的句式和表达逻辑

tasks.text: 精读前 5 篇文章（理解基本概念）
观看前 3 个视频（视觉化学习）
泛读后 5 篇文章（拓展应用场景）
观看后 3 个视频（加深理解）
复习词汇表与必学内容

mustLearn.title: 高频表达：Cost of Living
mustLearn.content:
English: The cost of living is rising every year.
中文：生活成本每年都在上涨。
解析：'Cost of living' 是财经高频词，指维持一定生活水平所需的费用。搭配动词 rise/go up 使用。

mustLearn.title: 实用句型：Due To
mustLearn.content:
English: Prices are high due to inflation.
中文：由于通货膨胀，物价很高。
解析：'Due to' 表示原因，相当于 because of。后接名词或名词短语，常用于解释经济现象。

mustLearn.title: 核心动词：Protect
mustLearn.content:
English: You need to protect your savings.
中文：你需要保护你的储蓄。
解析：'Protect' 意为保护。在理财语境中，常指抵御通胀风险，保持购买力。

mustLearn.title: 对比表达：More Than Before
mustLearn.content:
English: We pay more than before for food.
中文：我们为食物支付的比以前更多。
解析：'More than before' 是简单的比较结构，用于描述变化。适合 A2 学习者描述通胀影响。

mustLearn.title: 理财建议：Make a Budget
mustLearn.content:
English: It is wise to make a budget.
中文：制定预算是明智的。
解析：'Make a budget' 指规划收支。'Wise' 表示明智的，常用于建议句型。

expand.title: 文化注释：CPI 指数
expand.content: CPI (Consumer Price Index) 是衡量通胀的关键指标。新闻中常说 'CPI is up'，意味着物价普遍上涨。

expand.title: 同义替换：Increase
expand.content: 在财经英语中，increase 可替换为 rise, go up, climb, grow。例如：Prices rose last month.

expand.title: 背景知识：央行角色
expand.content: Central Bank（中央银行）通过调整 Interest Rate（利率）来控制通胀。利率高时，存钱更有吸引力。

expand.title: 进阶例句：Purchasing Power
expand.content: Inflation reduces your purchasing power. (通货膨胀降低了你的购买力。) 这是更专业的表达方式。

expand.title: 常见误区：Saving Cash
expand.content: 在高通胀时期，仅持有现金（cash）可能会贬值。 diversify investments（分散投资）是常见建议。

articles.title: What Is Inflation
articles.content: Inflation is when prices go up over time. Imagine you buy bread today for one dollar. Next year, the same bread might cost one dollar and ten cents. This means your money buys less than before. It happens in many countries around the world. When inflation is high, people worry about their wallets. They need to spend carefully on daily goods. Banks try to control this economic problem. They change interest rates to help. For you, it means saving is hard sometimes. But you can learn to manage money better. Understanding inflation helps you plan your future. You know why things cost more now. You can adjust your budget accordingly. Do not panic about the changes. Just learn the financial basics. Knowledge is power for your finance.
articles.zh: 解释通货膨胀的基本定义及其对购买力的影响。
points: go up: 上涨，用于描述价格变化
buy less than before: 比以前买得少，表示购买力下降
manage money: 管理金钱，理财常用表达

articles.title: Why Prices Rise
articles.content: Why do prices rise in the store? There are many reasons for this change. Sometimes, the cost to make things is higher. Oil and transport cost more money. Companies need to pay workers too. If they pay more, they sell products for more. This is called cost-push inflation. Another reason is demand. If many people want to buy one thing, the price goes up. This is demand-pull inflation. Money supply matters as well. If there is too much money in the economy, value drops. Governments print money sometimes. This can cause prices to increase fast. Understanding these reasons helps you see the big picture. You know it is not just one thing. It is a complex system of trade.
articles.zh: 分析物价上涨的多种原因，包括成本和需求。
points: cost to make things: 制造成本
demand: 需求，经济学核心词汇

articles.title: The Grocery Store
articles.content: Let us look at the grocery store example. You walk in with a shopping list. Last month, milk was three dollars. Today, it is three dollars and fifty cents. Eggs are also more expensive. You feel the difference in your wallet. This is real life inflation. It affects what you eat for dinner. Families need to change their habits. They might buy cheaper brands now. Or they buy less meat and more vegetables. Small changes add up over time. You save a little each week. But the total cost is still higher. Cashiers scan the items quickly. The final number on the screen is big. You pay with card or cash. Every dollar counts in this economy.
articles.zh: 通过超市购物场景描述通胀对日常生活的具体影响。
points: Every dollar counts: 每一分钱都很重要

articles.title: Salary And Value
articles.content: Your salary is important during inflation. If prices go up, you need more income. But does your pay increase too? Sometimes yes, sometimes no. If your salary stays the same, you are poorer. Your real value goes down. Workers ask bosses for more money. They want to keep their lifestyle. Companies might give a raise. But not everyone gets it. This creates stress for families. You need to plan your career well. Learning new skills helps you earn more. A higher income protects you from price rises. You can still save for holidays. Do not wait for others to help. Take action to improve your situation. Financial security is a good goal.
articles.zh: 讨论工资与通胀的关系，以及收入对生活质量的影响。
points: income: 收入，比 money 更正式
stay the same: 保持不变

articles.title: Saving Strategies
articles.content: How can you save money now? You need smart strategies for your wallet. First, make a budget plan. Write down what you spend every day. Coffee and lunch add up quickly. Second, cook at home more often. Restaurant food is very expensive now. Third, compare prices before you buy. Use apps to find good deals. Fourth, buy things on sale. Wait for discounts if you can. Fifth, stop buying unnecessary things. Do you really need that new phone? Maybe wait for next year. Small habits make a big difference. You keep more cash in the bank. This helps you feel safe. Safety is important for your mind.
articles.zh: 提供应对通胀的具体储蓄策略和生活建议。
points: unnecessary things: 不必要的物品

articles.title: Investing Basics
articles.content: Saving is good, but investing is better. When inflation is high, cash loses value. You need to grow your money. Stocks and bonds are common ways. Stocks mean you own part of a company. If the company grows, you make profit. Bonds are like loans to the government. They pay you interest over time. Real estate is another option. Houses often keep value well. But you need a lot of money first. Start small if you are young. Learn about the market risks. Do not put all money in one place. Diversify your investments carefully. Ask experts for advice if needed. Long term thinking is key here. You build wealth for the future.
articles.zh: 介绍基础投资知识，说明投资如何抵御通胀。

articles.title: Central Bank Role
articles.content: Who controls the money system? The Central Bank plays a big role. In the US, it is the Federal Reserve. They watch the economy closely. If inflation is too high, they act. They raise interest rates usually. This makes borrowing money expensive. People buy fewer houses and cars. Demand goes down slowly. Then prices stop rising fast. If economy is weak, they lower rates. This helps people spend more. It is a balancing act always. They want stable prices for everyone. Your bank savings rate changes too. When rates are high, save more. When rates are low, invest more. Follow the news to know their plans.
articles.zh: 解释中央银行如何通过利率政策控制通货膨胀。
points: raise interest rates: 提高利率

articles.title: Global Differences
articles.content: Inflation is not the same everywhere. Some countries have high rates. Others have low rates stable. Developing nations often face more problems. Their currency might lose value fast. Imported goods cost much more there. Rich countries have better control tools. They have strong banks and laws. But even they face crises sometimes. Energy prices affect all nations. Oil is used for transport globally. If oil price jumps, everyone pays more. Travel becomes expensive for tourists. Shipping costs rise for businesses. You see this in local shops. Global events change your local wallet. We are connected in this economy.
articles.zh: 对比不同国家的通胀情况及其全球关联性。

articles.title: History Lesson
articles.content: History teaches us about money problems. In the past, some countries had hyperinflation. Prices doubled every day sometimes. People carried bags of cash for bread. Money became worthless paper quickly. This hurts normal people most. Savings disappear overnight sadly. Governments failed to manage well. Today, we learn from those mistakes. Policies are stricter now usually. We try to keep stability. But history can repeat itself. We must stay alert and wise. Read about economic history books. Know what happened in the 1970s. Oil crisis caused high inflation then. Lessons from the past protect us. We do not want that again.
articles.zh: 通过历史案例说明恶性通胀的危害及教训。

articles.title: Future Planning
articles.content: What should you do for the future? Start planning your finance today. Do not wait for problems to come. Set clear goals for your life. Buy a house or travel more? Save for education or retirement? Inflation will continue probably. You need to grow your wealth. Keep learning about money matters. Read books and watch videos. Talk to friends about ideas. Join online communities for tips. Protect your income sources well. Have more than one job if possible. Side income helps a lot. Stay healthy to work longer. Your mind is your best asset. Plan well and live happily.
articles.zh: 总结个人应对未来的理财规划建议。
points: Set clear goals: 设定清晰目标
